# DealsGlobe – Global Amazon Deals Hub
> Curated Amazon deals auto-routed to local stores in 10 countries. US, UK, Canada, Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Poland and Sweden.

## About
DealsGlobe is a global Amazon affiliate deals hub. We detect visitors' countries and automatically connect them to their local Amazon store — amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.ca, amazon.de, amazon.fr, amazon.es, amazon.it, amazon.nl, amazon.pl, amazon.se. All links use affiliate tag brightlane201-20. Commissions earned via Amazon Associates program.
